conventions.bracket: [Z_i, Z_j]_0 = sum_k c[i,j,k] Z_k; entries [i, j, k, c]
conventions.gamma: kappa-coefficient: [Z_i,Z_j]_gb = [Z_i,Z_j]_0 + kappa*gamma(Z_i,Z_j); entries [i,j,k,coef] for gb param = 1
conventions.gamma_scalar_part: component of gamma along the unit K = 1 (killed by ad); entries [i,j,coef]
conventions.explicit_f: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi[i,j] Z_i; entries [j, i, phi]; gamma = delta f
